title: Apply for boarding house registration
summary: Find out about and apply for the registration of a boarding house in NSW.
intro:
Boarding houses provide accommodation for a fee. Generally, residents only occupy a room and share facilities such as kitchen or bathroom with others. Boarding house residents do not have the same rights as tenants.

There are 2 types of 'registrable’ boarding houses:

For more information on boarding houses visit NSW Fair Trading.

### Payment and fees

You will need to pay a fee to register a boarding house in NSW. For information on fees visit NSW Fair Trading.
who_can_apply: The premises must be becoming a registrable boarding house, or the proprietor must be becoming a new proprietor of the premises.
what_you_need: The completed form Notification to register a boarding house on the Register of Boarding Houses – PDF
Payment for the lodgement fee (paid online)

how_to_steps.text: Download and complete the form Notification to register a boarding house on the Register of Boarding Houses – PDF.
Pay the lodgement fee online as per the instructions on the form.
Lodge your application and your fee receipt:
a boarding premises becoming a registrable boardinghouse, or
the proprietor becoming a new proprietor of the premises.

faqs.a: Boarding houses provide accommodation for a fee, where residents generally occupy a room and share facilities like the kitchen or bathroom with others. Boarding house residents do not have the same rights as tenants.

faqs.q: How do I register a boarding house?
faqs.a: You must download and complete the form Notification to register a boarding house on the Register of Boarding Houses – PDF, pay the lodgement fee online, and then lodge your application and fee receipt.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about boarding houses?
faqs.a: For more information on boarding houses, visit NSW Fair Trading.
